_about: Version 84: the relay server (TURN) for online co-op and voice. Put the login from Metered's Open Relay (or Cloudflare) in iceServers, e.g. {"urls": ["turn:a.relay.metered.ca:80", "turn:a.relay.metered.ca:443", "turns:a.relay.metered.ca:443?transport=tcp"], "username": "...", "credential": "..."}. Empty: direct links only (Google STUN), with Firebase as the backup for button presses.
